propositions: Deterministic criteria assembly raises CriteriaError but workflow recorder preserves only undifferentiated string exception, losing typed failure identity
Generic plan-review verdict dispatch misroutes all unrecovered workflow failures through LLM-degradation tail, unconditionally stamping llm_unavailable=true even when no provider call executed
Malformed repository criteria configuration produces unsigned INDETERMINATE with llm_unavailable:true, misdirecting operators to provider credentials instead of installed-build/config mismatch
Fix captures CriteriaError at assemble boundary with stable failure_kind marker and routes only that structured marker through dedicated config-fault verdict path before generic LLM degradation
Config-fault verdict preserves deterministic findings and DET coverage while omitting affirmative llm_unavailable flag and emitting actionable diagnostic naming installed-rebar-build as suspect
Genuine LLMUnavailableError paths and deterministic blockers remain behaviorally unchanged; config fault becomes INDETERMINATE unless deterministic blocker makes it BLOCK
